title: Supply Chain Finance Programme Pricing Model
description: Model the economics of SCF programmes — reverse factoring, receivables discounting, and dynamic discounting — from buyer and supplier perspectives. Compare cost vs. WACC, yield to funder, and NPV of early payment.
